admission_order: Bind all9owned terminals, completion/source/release/payload hashes, original mask signatures and common VALID bundle before opening any score or array; no subset or partial family.
implementation: Concise companion specification; sealed Stage1 compare.py remains unchanged.
inputs: Exact9completed records and actual raw/direct-wait/absence terminal custody, original sealed source/release hashes.
Exact server-only SELECTED_MEMBER_LOGITS.npz factual logits, selected epochs and saved selected_prediction_signatures for every record.
One exact VALID_ONLY.npz/custody shared by all9; no TRAIN/TEST/full-label/model/checkpoint input needed.
limitations: Correct masks describe selected factual predictions only. Coverage/pooling changes do not replace the frozen screen or competent-reference requirement. Counts alone cannot establish useful complementarity or causal mechanism.
mismatch: Preserve FAILURE.json with expected/derived signature identity and input custody; stop. Do not change predictions, retry another backend/threshold, open TEST, run a forward or chase tiny metric floats to force agreement.
readouts: Distribution of0..4correct members; any-correct/all-correct masks/counts, total and perclass.
Pool correct with zero correct members; pool wrong despite at least one correct alternative.
No-correct-member common errors and unanimous same wrong-rival class errors.
Core-minus-own actual member repair/introduced-error masks under fixed route-index correspondence; no arbitrary independent-member pairing.
Core-minus-own/independent bank pooled repairs and introduced mistakes, gains/losses of any-correct coverage, and true intersections of error masks.
recomputation: On the exact bound Torch/provider/device, derive raw-logit member argmax and original mean-of-member-softmax pooled argmax from stored factual float32 logits. No model forward, retraining, calibration, threshold or NLL/float-chasing pass.
required_exact_verification: Ordered pooled/member argmax prediction SHA256 via the same dtype/shape/C-order fingerprint as sealed train.py.
Ordered pooled correct mask and4member correct-mask SHA256 against saved signatures.
Integer role/class correct counts, selected epoch and VALID order.
